newsitem.title: FINLAND: COURT DISMISSES CHARGES VS EX-KOP CHIEFS - RADIO.
newsitem.headline: COURT DISMISSES CHARGES VS EX-KOP CHIEFS - RADIO.

text.p: The Helsinki district court on Thursday dismissed charges against former executives of bank Kansallis-Osake-Pankki (KOP) linked to the bank's share issue in the autumn of 1994, Finnish radio news reported.
Banking group Merita Oy, into which KOP merged in 1995, later issued a statement saying the court had dismissed all charges connected with KOP's Kansallisanti share issue.
Among those who had been facing charges were Merita President Pertti Voutilainen, the former chief executive of KOP.
The charges were linked to information about big investors' commitment to subscribe the issue given as part of the marketing of KOP's share issue, Merita said earlier this autumn.
